description: This file defines the AppConfiguration class, which provides methods to manage application properties within a Spring-managed component.

classes.name: AppConfiguration
classes.description: Spring component that manages application properties and provides access to property values.

methods.name: getProperties
methods.description: Returns the Properties object containing application configurations.

methods.name: setProperties
methods.description: Sets the Properties object used for configuration.

methods.name: getProperty
methods.description: Retrieves the value for a given property key, logs a warning if properties are not loaded.
